tailored:
Dear koppla team,

What draws me to koppla is that you're building scheduling software for an industry that still runs on spreadsheets and phone calls — I've spent 20 years inside another heavily regulated, operational industry at Casino Cosmopol, and I know how much value good tooling brings when timelines and coordination actually matter.

On the technical side, I've built fullstack products rather than exercises. For TalentHiv, I designed and built the frontend in Next.js/React/TypeScript and the backend with FastAPI, including a REST API with clear structure, a PostgreSQL schema with migrations, validation, error handling, and testing with Pytest. On VoiceHive Hotels I worked with Docker/Kubernetes and real-time systems. TypeScript, React, Tailwind and REST APIs are where I work daily, and I want to grow into a fullstack role — exactly the path you describe.

I'm currently finishing my programming/AI education at Lexicon (graduating August 2026), and I bring a product mindset: GDPR features, cost-aware architecture, and features designed around real user needs. I'm an EU citizen open to relocating to Berlin and comfortable with a hybrid setup.

I'd love to talk about how I can contribute to koppla's product.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
+46 737 819 988 | tonyforan007@hotmail.com
